eyebrow: Pick the chart for the question

code:
fig, ax = plt.subplots(
    1, 3, figsize=(12, 3.5))
ax[0].hist(x, bins=30)
ax[0].set_title("Histogram")
ax[1].boxplot(x, vert=False)
ax[1].set_title("Box plot")
x.plot.kde(ax=ax[2])
ax[2].set_title("Density (KDE)")
plt.savefig("shapes.png", dpi=120)
caption: x holds 5,000 illustrative right-skewed order values.
Output of the code above (illustrative data). Note the density curve leaking below zero.

code:
q1, q3 = x.quantile([.25, .75])
iqr = q3 - q1
fence = q3 + 1.5 * iqr

round(fence, 2)    # 87.82
(x > fence).sum()  # 283
caption: 283 of 5,000 flagged: a flag to look, not to delete.
